title: Cale is enraged about the corps

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Let me guess: you saw it too? Fucking ridiculous, right? Absolute total garbage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess: you saw it too? Fucking ridiculous, right? Absolute total garbage.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: The corps! How are you not enraged by them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The corps! How are you not enraged by them?

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: They just posted their required financial reports to see which CEO's can gloat at the annual shareholder's parade.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They just posted their required financial reports to see which CEO's can gloat at the annual shareholder's parade.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Yes! And all the while people are drowning, unable to feed themselves, and then we have trillionaires living in a completely different world!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! And all the while people are drowning, unable to feed themselves, and then we have trillionaires living in a completely different world!

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: I'd rather have CorpSec hold me over the vents while they pump out pure acid. Least then I wouldn't be saddled with this debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd rather have CorpSec hold me over the vents while they pump out pure acid. Least then I wouldn't be saddled with this debt.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Nothing. That's the problem. We're resigned to this and it sucks. All of these things are just so definite. So final. We've lost the ability to try and adopt change.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. That's the problem. We're resigned to this and it sucks. All of these things are just so definite. So final. We've lost the ability to try and adopt change.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Thanks, that actually sounds good. And it's super nice of you. It's why you'll never be one of them. You have a heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, that actually sounds good. And it's super nice of you. It's why you'll never be one of them. You have a heart.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Indeed it is. Only thing we can hope for is to find a little connection while we can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed it is. Only thing we can hope for is to find a little connection while we can.

nodes.speaker: Cale Wyer
nodes.text: Twenty three percent increase over the last year! Twenty-three-per-cent. Are you fucking kidding me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Twenty three percent increase over the last year! Twenty-three-per-cent. Are you fucking kidding me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah! Total bullshit...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have no idea what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean more than I already am?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean more than I already am?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You mean more than I already am?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You mean more than I already am?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Eh, not worth being angry about what you can't control.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, not worth being angry about what you can't control.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Eh, not worth being angry about what you can't control.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Eh, not worth being angry about what you can't control.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Geez, seriously?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would probably feel different if you're one of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would probably feel different if you're one of them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would probably feel different if you're one of them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would probably feel different if you're one of them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it. I just don't know what we can do about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it. I just don't know what we can do about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get it. I just don't know what we can do about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get it. I just don't know what we can do about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you come by the stand and have a meal? On the house, Cale.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you come by the stand and have a meal? On the house, Cale.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you come by the stand and have a meal? On the house, Cale.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you come by the stand and have a meal? On the house, Cale.

nodes.text: Sad state of affairs.
